name: Natalia Amari
title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker, Somatic Experiencing Practitioner, AASECT Certified Sex Therapist
description: Relational Trauma Therapist + Somatic Sexologist. Serving individuals and couples, online, from Texas to Australia. My approach integrates wisdom on attachment, relationships, somatics, trauma, sexuality, and culture with liberation-minded values to create vivid, reparative experiences in psychotherapy. At the core, my passion lies in working with survivors of childhood abuse, domestic, and sexual violence. Many of the people I work with are of the LGBTQIA+, BIPOC, Kink/Poly, Sex Worker and Neurodivergent communities.
specialties: relational trauma, somatic experiencing, sex therapy, sexuality, LGBTQIA+, kink/poly, sex workers, neurodivergent, couples
identity: neurospicy, closeted (queer and witchy) [describing herself growing up]
